landing.hero.title: Build together with your parish
landing.hero.subtitle: GrottoWorks gathers plans, materials, donations, work hours and progress of the grotto — from the church to every community — in one transparent place, replacing scattered group chats.
landing.hero.cardSub: Track every work area of the season
landing.about.title: Fewer loose messages — more transparency
landing.about.sub: Instead of tracking work through group chats and manual spreadsheets, every work area shares one place that shows what is missing and the real progress.
landing.about.card1.title: Clearer than a chat thread
landing.about.card1.desc: Every screen answers at a glance: what is still missing, who is doing it and how far along it is.
landing.about.card2.title: Transparent to the last dong
landing.about.card2.desc: Quantities, costs and work hours always trace back to their source record.
landing.about.card3.title: Coordination across communities
landing.about.card3.desc: A community short on skills or materials is supported by another in time.
landing.areas.title: Five key areas of a parish Christmas season
landing.areas.sub: Each area has its own leader, material list, tasks and progress — at both parish and community level.
landing.zone.grotto.title: Christmas grotto
landing.zone.grotto.desc: The signature work raised at the parish centre and at each community's gathering point: rock frame, scenery, the Holy Family and warm lighting.
landing.zone.tree.title: Christmas tree & scenery
landing.zone.tree.desc: Highlights at the church yard and community gates: load-bearing frames, ribbons, bells and a lit star of hope.
landing.zone.lighting.title: Festive lighting system
landing.zone.lighting.desc: Artistic light runs along main roads and alleys, keeping the scene brilliant while staying electrically safe for everyone.
landing.zone.yard.title: Church yard & grounds
landing.zone.yard.desc: Tidying paths, flower beds and the welcome area — where parishioners gather throughout the season.
landing.zone.stage.title: Performance stage
landing.zone.stage.desc: The carol and Nativity-play area: backdrops, sound and lighting installation and a well-built backstage.
landing.download.title: Get GrottoWorks on your phone
landing.download.sub: Volunteers check in their hours, update tasks and send photo evidence right on site — while the committee reviews everything on the web.

shell.roleNote.PARISH: System administrator: create Christmas seasons and manage the parish, work areas, accounts and shared settings.
shell.roleNote.COMMUNITY: Coordinate the whole parish in the season: track progress per area, approve purchase requests and wrap up afterwards.
shell.roleNote.LEADER: Own the assigned areas: create tasks, assign volunteers, log timesheets and report results.
shell.roleNote.MATERIAL_OFFICER: Manage parish materials: request and confirm purchases, record donations and borrowed items, allocate to areas.
